subject: How to change arrows position so that they all originate from the same point

messages.author: dd8507309f8545e1
messages.subject: How to change arrows position so that they all originate from the same point
parts:
Dear all,

I am plotting this graph below and I would like all arrows emerging from a latent variable to emerge from the exact same point on the graph. do you know how to do so ?
Thanks

##### GRAPHES ########

rm(edg)
rm(nod)
rm(graph_data)

# disposition des variables sur un quadriLLage
lay <- get_layout(

  "zmem_final","","","","","CALGAR_cor","","",
 
  "zatt_final","","","","","","","",
 
  "","","metacog","","","","","",
 
  "zlang_final","","","", "","","","",
 
  "zexec_final","","","","","","","",
 
  "","EGF_cor","","","","","","SQOL",
 
  "","","","functioning","","","lifequality","",
 
  "","PSP_","","","","","","EQ5D_cor",
 
   rows = 8)


#représentation graphique par défaut
graph_sem(model=fit,layout="tree")


# paramétrisation des nœuds et flèches
edg <- get_edges(fit,label=paste(est_sig_std))
nod <- get_nodes(fit,label=paste(name))

# changer la taille de certains noeuds
graph_data <- prepare_graph(model = fit,
                            layout = lay,
                            edges =edg,
                            nodes=nod,
                            rect_width= 1.7,
                            rect_height= 0.6,
                            ellipses_width = 2.5,
                            ellipses_height = 2)
plot(graph_data)
 

#changer le nom des noeuds
nod=nodes(graph_data)

nod$label=c("Calgary Scale","EGF","EQ5D","Functioning","Quality of Life","Metacognitive\nAccuracy","PSP","SQOL","Attention","Executive","Language","Memory")

#changer la couleur des boites
nod$colour="black"

#changer la couleur des labels des noeuds
nod$label_colour="black"

# changer la taille des labels des noeuds
nod$label_size = 4

# mettre en gras certains labels des noeuds
nod$label_fontface="plain"

#commande pour appliquer les changements sur les noeuds
nodes(graph_data) <- nod
plot(graph_data)

edg=edges(graph_data)

#changer épaisseur des flèches
edg$alpha=0.4

edg[edg$from=="metacog" & edg$to=="functioning","alpha"]=1
edg[edg$from=="metacog" & edg$to=="lifequality","alpha"]=1

#changer couleur des flèches
edg$label_colour="black"

#changer taille label flèche
edg$label_size=3

edges(graph_data) <- edg

# virer certaines flèches comme les variances résiduelles
edges(graph_data) = edg[(edg$op!="~~") |

(edg$op=="~~" & edg$lhs=="EF" & edg$rhs=="SP"),]


# pour voir le résultat

plot(graph_data)
